note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every entry). Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; facts are drawn from the sources named beside each guide, never copied from them. Each trophy also carries numbered steps — what to do, in order — built from the same cited sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, on a single playthrough with no online trophies. Keep cheats off the whole run: PowerPyx and GTABase both report that cheats switch off trophies and saving.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — nothing extra is needed for this one.
Keep cheats off the whole run: PowerPyx and GTABase report cheats switch off trophies and saving.
One playthrough, about 200 hours; no online trophy and no difficulty requirement.

The bank-vault robberies Chapter 4 introduces feed Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. The 100% checklist appears only after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx stresses the thresholds are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion.
steps: Finish the story — the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.

Work the forgiving thresholds: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Most of it falls out of the other trophies; the checklist itself tells you what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the quickest: PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridges runs the fastest. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
steps: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Mix them freely; PowerPyx calls the under-the-bridge runs the fastest.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them on its own, so this usually pops by itself while you chase the other trophies.
steps: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, and a stunt.
Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done.
The rest appear as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. PowerPyx reports the gold times are not too hard, and the ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. All 42 golds are also on the 100% checklist, so this is not optional for the platinum.
steps: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.
PowerPyx reports the gold times are not too hard; ranges also raise Focus, which helps Gunslinger.
Work through the ranges after the story, when you can reach them all freely.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, so one win per location is enough. The drone races also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and all of them are required for the 100% checklist.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, one win per location is enough.
Race locations are marked once the map is unfogged; take them in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so you only need to win half of them, and each location counts once. Races also feed Master of None.
steps: Win 20 different races — PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations, so win half of them.
Each location counts once; a second win at the same spot adds nothing.
Pick the short, easy circuits first.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. The challenge itself is the unlock, not just catching a fish. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, wait for Cal's text marking a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — every level, at least once; you do not need to beat all of its challenges. There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world.
steps: Finish one arcade game all the way through — every level, at least once.
Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind play on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world.
Pick whichever you like best; one finished game is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-mission questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All of them stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call, then her text with her Belville address.
Finish her 5-mission questline: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: 7 shipwrecks in total. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he calls, then appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so the line is not missable.
steps: After the mission Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call — he appears as a green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the 7 shipwrecks he marks with purple chest icons; use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back.
Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-mission questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and all of it stays available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish Billy's 5-mission questline: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.

steps: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — only Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count.
Kirk: the Skunk Ape line. Kyle: the McKittrick Farm line. Yago: the street-race line. Pilot Pete: the Last Mile line.
PowerPyx warns the Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie lines do NOT count.

steps: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, use the Key Cloner and watch for Randy's Wish List.
Deliver 16 sports cars he wants — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, then deliver to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).

steps: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple markers to Synthetic Labs and destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter.
Once enough labs are down, Tyrone offers Spin On This — finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2, and you cannot do the last one until both characters are playable together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, at Jason's house, Lucia will talk about meditating in the kitchen in the morning (PowerPyx reports this happens after the mission Down to Earth) and walk out to the balcony — follow her, accept, and she teaches you to meditate. That balcony meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, but its author had done it when the trophy popped — do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this does not threaten A Long Road either way.
steps: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony to meditate — this is gone for good after Chapter 1.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2.
You cannot finish until both characters are playable together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it — the line is Jason-only). PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work through Bret's line and it will come.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, wait for Bret's text (Jason only) marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he marks with purple icons and bring them to him.
His first quest also gives the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.

Cards are found across Leonida; the 100% checklist does not require card sets at all, so this is a standalone cleanup trophy best done in free-roam after the story.
steps: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — pick the sets whose cards sit closest together.
Cards are found across Leonida; the 100% checklist does not require card sets at all.
Do this in free-roam cleanup after the story.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up to open it, then hold R1 to scan what you are looking at. steps: Open the WAiNK phone app (hold Up), look at a landmark and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan any 100 locations — PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Scan as you travel; the same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there — leave it for late, when dozens will already be done without trying. With 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, you can skip the hardest ones entirely.
steps: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges — the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; scrolling over one shows a checkmark when it is done.
With 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, skip the hardest ones entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the bank vaults there always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) so you free-roam together.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then break away on a fast sports bike and leave the red heat zone.
PowerPyx's easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the red and blue flashing wanted state has to stay up the whole time, not the red heat zone. This needs both characters together, so it is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
steps: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level.
PowerPyx recommends an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
Try the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
If the pop does not come after the third store, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the last shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops long before that target is done.
steps: Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Scan 100 vehicles — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by.
Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you have done the other trophies you will likely be at level 4 and this will come naturally.
steps: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted.
Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the window.
Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556.
PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang enemies.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
steps: At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal — one connected to a boarding bridge.
PowerPyx's easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4 — drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, enter the cockpit.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so be ready to fight your way out.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Climb into a Rhino tank parked in the south of the base and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map in unfogged areas. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies with green icons.
Enter through the back door and pick the lock with the Snap Gun — kicking the door trips the alarm.
Find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
PowerPyx's suggested spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vaults unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch the guard carry a briefcase of cash inside, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag).
After that mission, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (finish his Payday Loans quests first), marking vans with purple icons.
Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is automatic: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that opens the bank vaults — has you tail an armored truck to a bank, and robbing that vault counts as robbing the truck. Since the 100% checklist needs all 8 large bank jobs, this pops on its own.
steps: The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… has you tail an armored truck to a bank — robbing that vault counts as robbing the truck.
Or find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray).

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — in practice, fully unfog the whole map. Unfogging also reveals the activity, race and robbery icons that the other trophies need.
steps: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — in practice, fully unfog the whole map.
Fastest by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible.
Do it after the story, when the whole map is open and you can fly freely.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way there.
steps: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them.
Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, bottom right.
The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy — a small, deliberate moment, and one of the easiest in the list. PowerPyx names the exact drink and spot, so do not substitute another bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it out through the window: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. It only works with this blue Banshee, not any other car; it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner first, in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy).
Steal the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City — hack into it, drive forward and straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are further down the street.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. The bowling alley is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left — the trophy is not missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe.

At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch from the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. There are clubs all over Vice City, and a home gym becomes available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, when you can switch characters, raise strength for both Jason and Lucia to maximum.

Buy a fitness-club membership (filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon) and always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) — while one works out, the other trains automatically.
Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon).

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive, so avoid farming your way into it. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this usually fills up passively while you work on the other trophies.
steps: Turn on criminal-profile notifications first: Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do shifts your reputation.
Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500.
If it is last, PowerPyx's fallback is running over civilians and cops with a car, carefully — and avoid farming into Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests failing something once and succeeding on the second try. Until a guide confirms it, do not chase it. No source has confirmed a method yet, and this entry will not invent one.
steps: Do not chase this one yet — PowerPyx lists it as unconfirmed, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Play the Payday Loans content when it appears and check back — this guide will be updated as the community pins it down.
No source has confirmed a method yet, and this entry will not invent one.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky).
steps: Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone.
If no blinking car is parked at the roadside, drive away and come back — the spawn is slightly random.
When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods to the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On a motorcycle or a push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Despite the bowling name, this has nothing to do with the bowling alley trophy.
steps: On a motorcycle or push bike, kick pedestrians with Square.
Kick 10 within 60 seconds somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — keeping moving through a busy stretch.
Each kick has to land, and the timer is tight, so line up a run through a busy stretch rather than circling one spot.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist: bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, though those only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — PowerPyx notes Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative, not one trip, and comes naturally with the 100% checklist robberies.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. It is cumulative and counts everything — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts the shop types as 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, everything counts.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, being the most expensive.
Buy the gear you actually want for the other trophies and the total builds up on its own.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, for $160,000 in total. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots to register vehicles in.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), watch for the notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app, $160,000 in total — the 4 story garages do not count.
Fund them with robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and it lets you summon registered vehicles to your location. You need enough garages first — each garage adds one or more parking spots (see Little Boxes).
steps: Get garages first — each one adds parking spots (see Little Boxes).
The Scooter Bros app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
